optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Embedded Software Engineer, Agricultural Machinery Controllers
professionalSummary: Embedded software engineer with five years of experience on a harvester controller team, implementing controller functions against machine engineers' specifications under the team's software standard.
experienceHighlights: Implemented controller functions against machine engineers' specifications under the team's software standard.
Tested each function on the bench rig and supported the field test programme for two harvest seasons with diagnostics from controller logs.
Took each change through the software review process with release approval by the controller software lead.
Coordinated function changes with machine engineers through the function change log, recording proposed and received changes.
Wrote limitation sections and hand‑over conditions for each release note for the field test team.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: two change records with rig test records and release approvals, one season's diagnostics summary and one release note with its limitation section, with software repository references as a verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample sources establish the candidate’s experience and responsibilities related to controller function implementation, bench rig testing, field test support, software review participation, coordination with machine engineers, and release documentation. They do not provide evidence of any additional qualifications, certifications, or experiences beyond those stated.

evidence.text: Tested each function on the bench rig with the rig test records attached to the change, and supported the field test programme for two harvest seasons with diagnostics from the controller logs.
evidence.notes: Explicit bench rig testing and field test support.

evidence.text: Took each change through the software review process; the release approval was the controller software lead's, recorded in the release record.
evidence.notes: Shows participation in review and release approval by lead.

evidence.text: Coordinated function changes with the machine engineers through the function change log, recording which changes I proposed and which came from the machine engineers.
Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each release note for the field test team.
